日.mn: A picture of the sun. The old form was a circle with a dot in the middle; the brush squared the circle off, and the dot became the line inside.

w.s: 毎日日本語を話します。

一.mn: One finger laid flat on the table. One stroke, one thing — the simplest kanji there is.

w.s: りんごを一つください。

w.t: I like this one the most.

国.mn: A jewel (玉) locked inside a border wall (囗). A country is its treasure, kept safe inside its borders.

w.s: どの国から来ましたか。
w.t: Which country did you come from?
I want to work in a foreign country.

w.s: 国会は東京にあります。
中国語を習っています。

w.e: citizen; the people of a nation
w.s: 国民には義務があります。

会.mn: People (人) gathering under one roof, with 云 (a cloud of chatter) underneath. A meeting.

w.s: 駅で友だちに会います。
w.t: I will meet my friend at the station.

w.s: 父は会社で働いています。
w.t: My father works at a company.

w.s: 社会のルールを守ります。
w.t: I follow the rules of society.
I will take part in the tournament.

人.mn: A person seen from the side, mid-stride — two legs walking.

w.s: 日本人になりたいです。
日本の人口は減っています。
外国人の友だちがいます。

年.mn: A person carrying the harvested grain home on their back. One harvest = one year.

w.t: I came to Japan last year.
I will get married next year.
I have lived here for five years.

大.mn: A person (人) standing with both arms thrown out wide — "it was THIS big!"

w.s: 大きい家に住みたいです。
w.t: I want to live in a big house.

w.s: 大学で法律を学びました。

w.t: Family is the most important thing.

十.mn: Two hands crossed over each other — all ten fingers, complete.

w.s: 二十ページ読みました。

二.mn: Two fingers laid flat, one above the other. Two strokes, two.

w.s: パンを二つ買いました。
w.t: I bought two pieces of bread.
I will take two days off.

本.mn: A tree (木) with a mark at its base — pointing at the ROOT, the origin. The paper for books comes from that same tree.

w.s: 本を読むのが好きです。
日本の文化が好きです。
本社は大阪にあります。
w.t: The head office is in Osaka.

w.s: 日本語を勉強しています。

中.mn: A line driven straight through the centre of a box — dead centre.

w.s: かばんの中に本があります。
w.t: There is a book inside the bag.

w.s: 娘は中学校に通っています。
w.t: My daughter goes to junior high school.

w.s: 町の中心に住んでいます。
w.t: I live in the centre of town.

長.mn: An elder with long flowing hair leaning on a stick. Long hair, long life — and so, the leader.

w.s: 長い手紙を書きました。

w.t: I will look up the length of the river.

出.mn: One mountain (山) stacked on another — pushing UP and OUT of the ground.

w.t: I leave the house at seven.
I am not going out today.

w.s: いい思い出になりました。

三.mn: Three fingers laid flat, one above the other. Note the proportions when you write it: the middle stroke is the shortest and the bottom stroke the longest, so the character sits steady rather than toppling.

w.s: みかんを三つ食べました。

w.t: There are three people in my family.

w.s: 三時にお茶を飲みます。

同.mn: One (一) mouth (口) speaking from under the same roof (冂) — everyone saying the same thing.

w.s: 二人が同時に着きました。
w.t: The two of them arrived at the same time.

時.mn: The sun (日) over the temple (寺) — the temple bell marks the hour by the sun.

w.s: 子どもの時、京都にいました。
w.t: When I was a child, I was in Kyoto.
It is a story from the Edo period.

事.mn: A hand (⺕) holding a brush straight down, recording the affairs of state. Business, matters, things.

w.t: I will talk about an important matter.

w.s: 仕事は九時に始まります。
食事の前に手を洗います。
w.t: I wash my hands before a meal.

w.s: 体を大事にしてください。
用事があるので帰ります。
w.t: I have an errand, so I am going home.

自.mn: Originally a drawing of a nose. In Japan people point at their own nose to mean "me".

w.s: 日本には自由があります。
自転車で駅へ行きます。
w.t: I go to the station by bicycle.

行.mn: A crossroads seen from above — the place where you GO one way or the other.

w.t: I am going to Tokyo tomorrow.

w.s: 銀行でお金をおろします。
w.t: I withdraw money at the bank.

w.s: 学校の行事に参加します。
w.t: I take part in school events.

社.mn: The altar radical (礻) beside earth (土) — a mound of sacred earth, a shrine. Companies grew out of these local associations.

w.t: I go out into society and work.
I visit the shrine to pray.

w.s: 社長は今、出かけています。
w.t: The president is out right now.
My father is a company employee.

見.mn: A big eye (目) up on a pair of legs (儿) — an eye walking around, looking at everything.

w.s: 写真を見せてください。
意見を言ってください。

w.t: We go blossom viewing in spring.

月.mn: A crescent moon on its side. One moon-cycle = one month.

w.t: The moon is beautiful, isn't it?

分.mn: A sword (刀) cutting something into eight (八) parts — dividing. Once it is divided up, you can understand it.

w.s: あと五分待ってください。
自分の名前を書きます。

後.mn: Walking (彳) with a thread (幺) dragging behind slow feet (夂) — you fall BEHIND, you come AFTER.

w.s: 後ろを見ないでください。
w.t: Please do not look behind you.
I read it to the end.
I will keep going from now on as well.

前.mn: A knife (刂) trimming the meat (月) into eight (八) — you cut it BEFORE serving. What is cut goes out FRONT.

w.t: I will wait in front of the station.

w.s: 午前九時に始まります。
ここに名前を書いてください。
以前ここに住んでいました。

生.mn: A young plant pushing up out of the ground (土) — new life sprouting.

w.s: インドで生まれました。
百歳まで生きたいです。
w.t: I want to live to a hundred.
I ask the teacher a question.
My younger brother is still a student.

w.s: 日本の生活に慣れました。
w.t: I have got used to life in Japan.

五.mn: An hourglass pinched between two lines — a hand with all five fingers folded in.

w.s: 五月は気持ちがいいです。
五日に会議があります。
w.t: There is a meeting on the fifth.

発.mn: Two feet stepping apart (癶) above a bow being loosed — the arrow is DISCHARGED and DEPARTS.

w.s: 新しい星を発見しました。
発音を直してください。

間.mn: The sun (日) shining through a gate (門) — the GAP between the two doors.

w.s: 家と駅の間に公園があります。
w.t: There is a park between my house and the station.

w.s: 人間は間違えるものです。

w.t: It is warm during the daytime.

対.mn: A text (文) and a hand (寸) facing each other across a table — two sides FACING off.

w.s: 質問に対して答えます。
w.t: I answer in response to the question.
We will think of a countermeasure.

上.mn: A ground line with a mark standing UP above it. Write the tall vertical first, then the short right-hand tick, then the base line last — and remember it as the exact mirror of 下, which hangs its mark below the line instead.

w.s: 机の上に本があります。
w.t: There is a book on the desk.
Your Japanese is good, isn't it?

w.s: 十年以上住んでいます。
w.t: I have lived here more than ten years.

部.mn: A village (⻏) split into standing (立) mouths (口) — the town divided into DEPARTMENTS.

w.t: I report to the department head.

w.s: 一部の人が反対しました。
この部分が分かりません。
w.t: I do not understand this part.

東.mn: The sun (日) caught in the branches of a tree (木) — sunrise seen through the trees is the EAST.

w.t: I am waiting at the east exit.
Tohoku gets a lot of snow.

w.s: 中東のニュースを見ました。
w.t: I watched the news about the Middle East.

者.mn: An elder (耂) speaking over the sun (日) — the one who does the telling. This is the "-er" on the end of a job.

w.s: 私は田中という者です。
w.t: I am a person called Tanaka.

w.s: 若者が集まっています。
新聞記者になりたいです。
w.t: I want to become a newspaper journalist.

w.s: 参加者は五十人でした。

地.mn: Earth (土) plus 也 — soil stretching out flat in every direction.

w.t: I walk while looking at the map.

w.s: 地下に駐車場があります。
w.t: There is a car park underground.

w.s: 地方に引っ越しました。

w.t: I bought a piece of land.

w.s: 昨日、地震がありました。

合.mn: A lid coming down neatly onto a pot (口) — it FITS perfectly.

w.s: この服はよく合います。

w.t: In case of rain it is cancelled.

w.s: サッカーの試合を見ました。

市.mn: A cloth banner (巾) hanging under a lid — the flag over the marketplace, which grew into the CITY.

w.s: 京都市に住んでいます。
市民として投票します。
市役所で手続きをします。
w.t: I do the paperwork at city hall.
I go to the market in the morning.

w.s: 新しい市長が決まりました。

業.mn: A heavy wooden rack piled high with work — the craftsman's loaded bench. That is his TRADE.

w.s: 日本の産業は強いです。
この町は工業が盛んです。
祖父は農業をしています。

内.mn: A person (人) tucked in under a roof (冂) — safely INSIDE.

w.t: I will return it within three days.
I will show you the way to the station.

w.s: 手紙の内容を読みました。
w.t: I read the contents of the letter.
I am going out with my wife.

相.mn: An eye (目) looking at a tree (木) — and the tree "looks" back. Two things facing EACH OTHER.

w.t: I listen to what the other person says.

w.s: 相当時間がかかりました。
w.t: It took a considerable amount of time.
